holidays.name: Founding Day
holidays.description: Empire Founding — oaths sworn in frost
holidays.longDescription: Founding Day is observed on day 1 of month 1 in the Imperial Calendar. It is classified as a festival and is associated with Empire Founding — oaths sworn in frost . Communities use the occasion to preserve local memory, reinforce shared identity, and mark the passage of the calendar year. Practices vary by region and faction, so this observance may carry different political or religious meaning across the wider world.
